data.name: Hezekion
data.long_meaning: The name Hezekion is of Hebrew origin and is derived from the Hebrew word hazzak, which means 'to be strong'. It is also associated with the Hebrew phrase hazzakah yah, meaning 'God will be exalted'. This name was borne by several figures in the Old Testament, including Hezekiah, the king of Judah who reigned during the Babylonian siege of Jerusalem and led his people to repentance and restoration. In the New Testament, Hezekiah is also mentioned in the Book of Acts as having been miraculously saved from death by the apostle Paul.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith, trust, and reliance on God's strength and power.
data.numerology_meaning: A loving, caring, and nurturing personality. Hezekion is likely to be empathetic, generous, and peaceful.

in_english.name: Hezekion
in_english.long_meaning: Hezekion is a name of God, blessed, deliverer, and salvation. It is derived from the Hebrew name Hezekiah, meaning to strengthen, to deliver. In the Bible, Hezekiah is a king of Judah who trusted in God and was delivered from the Assyrian army. Hezekion is a name that reflects God's power and deliverance. It is a name that brings hope and salvation to those who call upon it. In Christian tradition, Hezekion is a name that represents God's love and deliverance. It is a name that encourages faith and trust in God's goodness and provision.

biblical_reference.note: The name Hezekion is derived from the Hebrew name Hezekiah, which is mentioned in the Bible as a king of Judah who trusted in God and was delivered from the Assyrian army.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hezekion carries a powerful message of strength, courage, and resilience in the face of adversity, which continues to resonate with many people today. It is a name that encourages those who bear it to be strong in the challenges they face, just as the Old Testament figure of Hezekiah led his people to withstand the mighty Babylonian army. In this way, Hezekion and its biblical associations can serve as an ongoing source of inspiration and motivation for those who carry this name.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name Hezekion is a reminder of the strength and power of God. The Hebrew origins of the name, with its connection to the phrase 'God will be exalted', emphasizes the divine source of our strength and the ultimate goal of our lives - to glorify God in all we do. This spiritual significance is reflected in the biblical figures who bore the name Hezekiah, who led their people to turn to God in times of crisis and to place their trust in His power and faithfulness. Ultimately, the name Hezekion invites us to be strong and courageous in our faith, relying on God's strength and power to carry us through the challenges of life and to bring glory to His name.

historical_references.reference: Hezekiah was a king of Judah, ruling from 715 to 687 BC. During his reign, he successfully defended Jerusalem against two major Assyrian invasions, led by Sennacherib and Ramman-Nirari III.

Hezekiah is remembered in the Bible for his religious reforms, which included the restoration of the Temple and the institution of regular offerings. He is considered a good and faithful king, who led Judah through a period of renewed spiritual vigor.
